commit.message:
Accept optional bounded native attachment list metadata

Match the published typed FilesV2 metadata shape for absent name and MIME fields and their 16384/1024 byte bounds. Retain explicit wrong-type rejection, existing MIME fallback, raw content comparison and every byte outside the row initializer.

Add three actual-decoder regression methods with thirteen declared cases. Source-reviewed only; no compiler, Native or Apple execution. Inline list requiredness and future ACK recovery remain separate.
